name: wake-meter
description: Shows what firstmate's notifications cost in its primary session and nudges a restart when context grows.

restartAtTokens.title: Restart nudge threshold
restartAtTokens.description: Context size, in tokens, past which an idle notification turn raises a restart toast (again every 50k more).

foldWakeRows.title: Fold notification rows
foldWakeRows.description: Draw each firstmate notification row in the transcript as one dim line (ctrl+o still shows it whole). Off by default until confirmed against a live session.
